title: One-step input seek machine
statement: There is a deterministic Turing machine with one work tape, Boolean symbols, and a single state, which it uses as its initial state. At every step, regardless of the scanned input symbol or work-tape contents, its transition is the action that moves the input head one step to the right and keeps the machine in that state.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of `inputMoveAction`, so the remaining work-tape and output behavior cannot be stated exactly.
